name: Scheduled Notice
description: Send one operator-authored, clearly labelled WhatsApp notice at a specified time.
author: OpenWA Community

enabled.title: Enable scheduled notice
enabled.description: When enabled, sends the configured notice once at the selected time.

sessionId.title: Sender session ID
sessionId.description: The OpenWA session that sends the message. Activate this plugin for that session.

message.title: Message
message.description: Write the notice yourself. The plugin adds an automated-message label.
